decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean pronunciation/phonetics SME or speech/acoustic reviewer
findings: Technical word-timestamp capability captured for 47 of 48 samples; no accuracy acceptance.
conditionsAndLimitations: Phone-tier release use and all speaking scores remain prohibited.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean pronunciation/phonetics SME or speech/acoustic reviewer
findings: Machine timestamps supplied without human gold timestamps.
conditionsAndLimitations: Reviewer must assess Korean boundary usability and phonological-process risk.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean SME, data owner, or calibration owner
findings: 48-speaker demographic sample supplied; device, environment, proficiency, repeated-take, and SME labels remain missing.
conditionsAndLimitations: Synthetic perturbations cannot be accepted as genuine device/environment coverage.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Speech/acoustic reviewer or qualified Korean speech SME
findings: Sixteen synthetic robustness probes aligned; full real acoustic calibration is not present.
conditionsAndLimitations: Real supported-device/environment matrix and reject-or-rerecord thresholds are still required.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Korean SME, acoustic reviewer, or fairness owner
findings: Alignment coverage is reported by available self-declared gender and age groups; score fairness is not established.
conditionsAndLimitations: Human score baselines and pre-approved disparity thresholds remain required.

decisions.requiredReviewerAuthority: Scoring, calibration, or release owner using pre-defined thresholds
findings: Two runs aligned the same 47 samples; three samples changed label sequences and maximum matching-boundary delta was 0.49 seconds.
conditionsAndLimitations: No pre-approved tolerance exists, so automatic acceptance is forbidden.
